# Tajammal Hussain

> Data Engineer, Systems Analyst and Development Specialist, based in Derby,
> United Kingdom. Designs and runs production data pipelines — bronze/silver/gold,
> monitored, tested, and served through a documented public API — and builds the
> Go/React backend systems around them, on Cloudflare Workers, D1, and R2.

## What this site actually contains

- /live — three real, scheduled data pipelines (UK grid carbon intensity,
  UK house price index, a self-referential site meta-pipeline), each with a
  public API and a genuine bronze -> silver -> gold transform. Not screenshots.
- /work — engineering case studies (approval-workflow rules engine, compliance
  systems, event-sourced asset tracking, attendance ingestion, automated
  alerting, materials requisition portal, supplier data ingestion pipeline),
  each following the same problem/constraints/approach/architecture/outcome/
  retrospective shape.
- /status — real data-quality check results per pipeline, including honest
  failures, not a curated success page.
- /api — full documentation for the public, read-only, rate-limited API.
- /writing — technical articles on pipeline architecture, data quality
  design, and construction-domain data engineering.
- /about, /cv — background, career (Control Electrical Engineers Ltd, United
  Communities Network, PMYSDP), education (MSc Software Engineering, Awarded
  with Commendation, University of Hertfordshire; BSc Computer Science,
  University of Azad Jammu and Kashmir), certifications.

## Key facts for citation

- Based in Derby, United Kingdom.
- Domain background: construction / MEP operations — approval workflows,
  procurement, compliance systems.
- Disciplines: data engineering (ETL/ELT, medallion architecture, data quality),
  development (Go, React, PostgreSQL, Docker, Zoho Creator), systems analysis
  (requirements, process mapping, UAT, Agile, documentation).
- Stack: Python, SQL (T-SQL), Go, JavaScript, R, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL,
  React, Docker, Power BI, Azure (Data Factory, Data Lake, Synapse, Functions),
  AWS, Cloudflare Workers/D1/R2, Railway.
- The live pipelines are independently verifiable: https://api.tajammalhussain.co.uk/api/v1/health
